remarks: Beautiful Authentic Front and Back Craftsman Houses located in Santa Monica Adjacent neighborhood. Designed and built by Michael J Kent, AIA, the 2946 SF Front House has five  Bedrooms and three full tiled Baths. The Living, Dining, and Family rooms all have detailed wood floors. The 1281 SF Back House has two large Bedrooms, One full Bath, Living-Dining-Kitchen space, and both structures have separate Laundry Rooms. Other features include Custom Craftsman details, 3-car onsite Parking Spaces, Fiber Optic Cable, Wired for Sound and Security Systems, Stainless Steel Appliances, Gourmet Kitchens, Wood Floors, Ceiling Fans, 3 Tankless Water Heaters, Dual Zone AC and Heat, and Private Courtyard
